structural_suites_default_lab.attribution: NOT an MP-A3 regression. The same failure class reproduces on the base without MP-A3. The Node gateway fails too, and it does not use torneos-edge-main. PGRST303 'JWT not yet valid' on the base shows intermittent container-vs-host clock lag in the Docker VM, and the Core contract's time-bound service auth and nonce windows are sensitive to that lag. Measured skew at rest was about 0.05 s: the lag is intermittent. Recommended: re-certify E2E on a lab host with a stable clock (e.g. Docker Desktop restarted) before MP-A4.
